CustomField.description: This field will measure the days an opportunity has been in the approval stage without advancing to the Docs Out Stage.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( Offer_Out_Date__c ), NOW() - APPROVAL_DATE__c , Offer_Out_Date__c - APPROVAL_DATE__c)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field will measure the days an opportunity has been in the approval stage without advancing to the Docs Out Stage.
CustomField.label: Days In Approval Stage
